tasks.spec:
You are updating Paperclip agent instruction files for a fleet of 22 AI agents. Your working directory contains a copy of the instruction files.

Your task: Update the AGENTS.md files for these 7 core agents by adding a '## Fleet Context' section before the final 'See [fleet-base.md]' line. The new section should contain:
1. A reference to fleet-surfaces-index.md: 'See [fleet-surfaces-index.md](../../../fleet-surfaces-index.md) for the complete fleet surface map, port registry, and health check commands.'
2. A '## Runtime Context' subsection with these key endpoints: Paperclip API at http://127.0.0.1:3100/api, Ringside at http://127.0.0.1:8700, Herdr workspace manager (herdr binary v0.7.3), Beads SSOT (bd CLI).
3. A '## Memory Planes' subsection listing: OB1 at :8787, Hindsight at :8888, Honcho at :8005, Holographic via fact_store tool.

Agents to update (relative paths from your working directory):
- core-agents/Coordinator.md
- core-agents/Coder.md
- core-agents/Fable.md
- core-agents/Researcher.md
- core-agents/Operator.md
- core-agents/Scout.md
- core-agents/Bright.md

For each file: read it, find the line 'See [fleet-base.md](../../../fleet-base.md) for the full roster, delegation commands, and work model.', insert the new sections BEFORE that line, then keep the fleet-base.md reference as the last line.

After updating all 7 files, write a summary file ./core-agents-refresh-summary.md listing each file and confirming the sections were added.

Do NOT modify the fleet-base.md reference line itself. Do NOT remove any existing content. Only add the new sections.
tasks.check: count=0; for f in core-agents/Coordinator.md core-agents/Coder.md core-agents/Fable.md core-agents/Researcher.md core-agents/Operator.md core-agents/Scout.md core-agents/Bright.md; do if [ -f "$f" ] && grep -q 'Fleet Context' "$f" && grep -q 'fleet-surfaces-index.md' "$f" && grep -q 'Memory Planes' "$f" && grep -q 'Runtime Context' "$f"; then count=$((count+1)); echo "PASS: $f has all required sections"; else echo "FAIL: $f missing required sections"; fi; done; if [ "$count" -eq 7 ]; then echo 'All 7 core agent files updated successfully'; exit 0; else echo "Only $count/7 files passed — check failed"; exit 1; fi
tasks.verified: All 7 core agent AGENTS.md files contain the Fleet Context, Runtime Context, Memory Planes, and fleet-surfaces-index reference sections.
